remarks: Set on 5 private acres in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings, this beautifully maintained home is on the market for the first time in nearly three decades. The property has been meticulously maintained and offers a true country club lifestyle with a tennis court, pool, and expansive grounds designed for recreation and relaxation. The main level features an open concept layout with abundant natural light, a dedicated office, and a wraparound deck overlooking the sweeping landscape and pool area. The upper level offers four bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with an updated ensuite bath and large walk-in closet. The fully finished walkout lower level adds exceptional versatility with a gym, additional flexible space and lots of storage. The house comes with an irrigation system, invisible fence and a driveway manometer. A rare opportunity to enjoy resort style living just minutes from town, schools, and train.
